description: Source code for EFI-related GPIO control, including pin initialization, management, and shutdown routines for engine components.

classes.name: EnginePins
classes.description: Manages engine-related GPIO pins, including initialization, reset, start, stop, and unregister routines.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Base class representing a GPIO output pin with methods to initialize, set, toggle, and get logic state.

classes.name: NamedOutputPin
classes.description: Derived class from OutputPin with a name and methods to set high/low states, used for identifiable pins.

classes.name: InjectorOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized output pin for injectors, with reset and stop functionalities.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized output pin for ignition coils, with reset functionality.

methods.name: EnginePins::stopPins
methods.description: Stops all engine-related pins (coils, injectors, auxiliary valves).

methods.name: EnginePins::unregisterPins
methods.description: Unregisters output pins for various engine components.

methods.name: EnginePins::reset
methods.description: Resets all injectors and coils to initial state.

methods.name: NamedOutputPin::setHigh
methods.description: Sets the pin to high (active) state.

methods.name: NamedOutputPin::setLow
methods.description: Sets the pin to low (inactive) state.

methods.name: OutputPin::setValue
methods.description: Sets the logical value of the pin, converting to electrical value if in production mode.

methods.name: OutputPin::toggle
methods.description: Toggles the current logic state of the pin.
